name: thanos_rule_no_evaluation_for10_intervals
title: Thanos Rule No Evaluation For10 Intervals
description: Thanos Rule has rule groups that did not evaluate for least 10x of their expected interval.

source.upstream_alert: Thanos Rule No Evaluation For10 Intervals
source.upstream_query: time() -  max by (job, instance, group) (prometheus_rule_group_last_evaluation_timestamp_seconds{job=~".*thanos-rule.*"})>10 * max by (job, instance, group) (prometheus_rule_group_interval_seconds{job=~".*thanos-rule.*"})
source.upstream_description: Thanos Rule {{$labels.job}} has rule groups that did not evaluate for at least 10x of their expected interval.
source.query_normalized: The upstream threshold could not be lifted out of the expression (its outermost operator is and/or/unless, or it compares against another series), so the expression is normalised to 1 per matching series and the alert fires on any match. The observed value in the notification is therefore always 1.

query_condition.promql: (time() -  max by (job, instance, group) (prometheus_rule_group_last_evaluation_timestamp_seconds{job=~".*thanos-rule.*"})>10 * max by (job, instance, group) (prometheus_rule_group_interval_seconds{job=~".*thanos-rule.*"})) * 0 + 1
